meta.title: Sustainability
meta.description: How SAWO builds sustainably, using responsibly sourced wood, waste-reduction practices, and energy-efficient manufacturing behind every sauna heater and room.

hero.title: SUSTAINABILITY
hero.subtitle: We care for you and the Earth

commitment.title: Our Commitment to Sustainability
commitment.desc: At SAWO, we blend wellness with environmental responsibility. Every sauna we craft embodies sustainability, from material selection to manufacturing processes. We strive to spread authentic Finnish sauna culture with high-quality, durable saunas that nurture health while respecting our planet.

energy.title: Energy Efficiency
energy.desc: Advanced technologies, including precision CNC machining, minimize energy consumption and reduce waste.

waste.title: Waste Reduction
waste.desc: We repurpose or recycle excess wood and materials, striving for zero waste in production.

nonToxic.title: Non-Toxic Treatments
nonToxic.desc: We avoid harmful chemicals, using toxin-free finishes to protect the environment and health. Our waste is certified non-toxic.

energySmart.title: Energy-Smart Sauna Design
energySmart.subtitle: Our saunas are engineered for optimal energy efficiency, ensuring a perfect sauna experience with minimal environmental impact.
energySmart.feature1: Heating systems are perfectly matched to sauna size to prevent energy waste.
energySmart.feature2: Some models feature smart thermostats for precise temperature control.
energySmart.feature3: Infrared technology is incorporated to reduce electricity consumption.
energySmart.bannerText: By choosing SAWO, you invest in a product made from sustainable materials, a manufacturing process that respects natural resources, and a healthier indoor environment.

wasteHierarchy.title: Waste into Worth: Closing the Loop
wasteHierarchy.intro: We follow the Waste Hierarchy Directive (EU) 2018/851, prioritizing waste minimization, reuse, and recovery

minimization.title: Waste Minimization
minimization.desc: Advanced cutting techniques limit unnecessary waste, using both parts of cut-offs to reduce material consumption.

reuse.title: Waste Reuse
reuse.desc: Any remaining wood pieces are repurposed into other designs.

recovery.title: Waste Recovery
recovery.desc: Sawdust and unsavable wood cut-offs fuel biomass boilers, powering our facilities with renewable energy and reducing our carbon footprint.

wellbeing.quotePrefix: Health and wellbeing is at the base of having a good life. Sustainability not only looks at the wellbeing of people, but also at the wellbeing of the Earth. At SAWO,
wellbeing.quoteMiddle: . We make sure you are taken care of with a sauna. We also do our best to make sure the Earth is taken care of.
wellbeing.quoteHighlight2: Wellbeing is Sustainability. Be well. Sauna well.
wellbeing.ctaText: Join us on our journey to make sustainable sauna experiences accessible and enjoyable worldwide. Experience the warmth of nature with a sauna that cares for you and the Earth.
